description: Agents Kit v2 oturum, mutasyon ve kapanış korumaları.

hooks.command: d="$(pwd -P)"; while [ ! -f "$d/.agents/validators/sh/agent-kit.sh" ]; do [ "$d" != / ] || exit 3; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; /bin/sh "$d/.agents/validators/sh/agent-kit.sh" session-context --discover-root --client codex --source hook --format text
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d = (Get-Location).Path; while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d '.agents\validators\ps\agent-kit.ps1') -PathType Leaf)) { $p = Split-Path -Parent $d; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($p) -or $p -eq $d) { throw 'AKE900 validator not found' }; $d = $p }; & (Join-Path $d '.agents\validators\ps\agent-kit.ps1') session-context -DiscoverRoot -Client codex -Source hook -Format text"
